scopeNotes: 54 current JUnit cases; older 46/52 snapshots overlap and are not cumulative.
JUnit scope ports are controlled; the 149-request separate normal-JAR acceptance uses real OrganizationScope/ProjectScope and real login/cache proxies.
Role-menu and user-role changes after warm login use production HTTP; no SQL role changes or manual Redis clearing.
Project VIEW grant/revoke use production authorization HTTP. Organization and commerce ownership facts are synthetic SQL fixture changes in the exclusive database.
Original V374 remains failed; HTTP PASS on V373 plus partial V374 is not complete migration PASS.

Final95 HTTP independently adds both-active company/project union, overlap deduplication, each-route/both-route revocations and amount masking. It runs in the same exclusive environment as 10000-row authorization-sparse sample.

The sparse sample returned 50 authorized IDs over3pages; actual RowsExamined10005/38/21, native SQL22.668706/0.891211/0.651081ms. No constant physical scan bound is claimed; no production index/migration changed.
